messages:
Ethan (Sales): folks — POC with NorthStar asking for 30% POC discount + 6mo reserved GPUs. Need to know exact CPQ fields to trigger deal desk/finance automatically so I can tell buyer timeline.

CPQ Bot: routing fields we evaluate: Discount__c, Commit_Months__c, Deal_Type__c, Special_Terms__c, dd_risk_score__c, dd_approval_needed__c, Infra_Commit__c, Infra_Security_Profile__c, LegalReview__c.

Kevin - Deal Desk: quick checklist: set dd_approval_needed__c = true, attach pricing worksheet + SOW. Current routing rules: IF Discount__c > 0.25 OR dd_risk_score__c >= 6 OR CONTAINS(Special_Terms__c, 'commit') THEN DealDeskRoute__c = 'Priority' ELSE IF Discount__c > 0.10 THEN DealDeskRoute__c = 'Standard' ELSE DealDeskRoute__c = 'Auto'. Also ensure DealDeskOwner__c = 'dealdesk_queue'.

Ethan (Sales): thanks. What SLAs can I quote to the buyer?

Kevin - Deal Desk: acknowledge within 24h. Priority pricing decision aim = 24-48h, Standard = 48-72h. Legal reviews vary (3-5 business days usually). If you need faster, set LegalPriority__c = true and provide justification.

Maria S: security note — sec questionnaire outstanding. If answers push dd_risk_score__c > 7 we auto-route to Security + Legal. Upload the questionnaire to the opp.

Ethan (Sales): buyer wants three special terms: EU data residency, liability cap change, and 30-day exit clause. Legal required on liability cap and exit, right?

Kevin - Deal Desk: correct — Deal Desk can approve pricing and ordinary commercial tweaks. Anything changing liability, termination, indemnity requires LegalReview__c = true. Attach redlines.

Julie Ops: infra presales fields: Infra_Commit__c (GPU-months) and Infra_Security_Profile__c (NONE, VPN, PRIVATE_LINK, HSM). Ops only escalates to Eng if Infra_Commit__c >= 100 GPU-months OR Infra_Security_Profile__c == 'HSM'.

Ethan (Sales): setting fields now: dd_approval_needed__c = true, Discount__c = 0.30, Commit_Months__c = 6, Special_Terms__c = 'EU-residency; liability-cap:customer; 30d-exit', LegalReview__c = true. Attaching worksheet + redlines.

CPQ Bot: opp updated. Computed route => DealDeskRoute__c: Priority. Notifying Kevin - Deal Desk.

LegalBot: automated note — redlines uploaded. Placed in legal queue. Flag LegalPriority__c if you need expedited review.

Kevin - Deal Desk: received. Creating DD ticket and will triage. If sec score remains <=7 and legal turn = standard, expect final answer in ~72h. Will post updates here.

Security Bot: sec questionnaire auto-score = 4 for now. Will update on new findings.

Ethan (Sales): perfect. I'll update with sec results. Appreciate the ETA.

Kevin - Deal Desk: closing loop — DD ticket created (DD-2026-114). @Ethan (Sales) ping if LegalPriority required. :thumbsup:
